result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make the inner reality of others impossible to ignore—so that no one could harm, dismiss, or exploit another without feeling the weight of it as if it were their own.

Not just empathy as a concept, but as a built-in human constraint: cruelty would feel self-inflicted, and indifference would be unbearable.

Most of the world’s deepest problems are kept alive by distance—between races, nations, classes, species, generations. I’d collapse that distance.
